summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Knook MVP. 15/15 pytest backend tests pass (auth/OTP, users, crushes-no-raw-phone, mutual match privacy, dev trigger-reveal, messages ObjectId fix, reveal/mutual reveal, unhook, 403 on non-active matches). End-to-end mobile UI flow works: phone → OTP (dev code 123456 visible) → profile → crushes tab (countdown 05:29:00 to 6:30 PM IST, 0/0 stats) → Add Crush FAB shows 10 mock contacts with CRUSH→Added toggle → Chats empty state shows 'Trigger reveal now (demo)' button → after trigger, Mystery Match row appears → chat send works with bubble on right → reveal flow shows 'You revealed.' → after both reveal, header switches to 'Bobby · Revealed · real names' → unhook sheet confirm routes to /chats and removes match. ONE FUNCTIONAL BUG found: Add Crush search filter matches all contacts for any non-numeric query because of OR condition with empty-digit substring. Two minor RN deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) printed by web preview.

ui_bugs.issue: Typing a non-numeric query (e.g. 'Aarav') does NOT filter the list — all 10 contacts remain visible. Root cause: filter uses `name.includes(q) || phone.replace(/\D/g,'').includes(q.replace(/\D/g,''))`. When q has no digits, `q.replace(/\D/g,'')` is '' and `phone.includes('')` is always true, so the OR is always true. Reference: /app/frontend/app/add-crush.tsx:25-27. Fix: only apply the phone-digits branch when the query actually has digits, e.g. `const qDigits = q.replace(/\D/g,''); return contacts.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (qDigits && c.phone.replace(/\D/g,'').includes(qDigits)));`.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears on app load (multiple screens). Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius usages to RN's new boxShadow API or platform-conditional styles.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move `pointerEvents` from JSX prop to a style entry.

action_items: Fix Add Crush search filter logic in /app/frontend/app/add-crush.tsx (lines 22-28) — gate the phone-digit substring check on qDigits being non-empty so non-numeric queries actually narrow the contact list.
Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow (RN 0.76+) to silence console warnings.
Replace JSX `pointerEvents` prop with `style.pointerEvents` wherever used.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 466-line file — fine for MVP but split into routers (auth/users/crushes/matches/messages/dev) before adding more features.
Privacy contract holds: GET /api/matches correctly excludes pending_reveal; raw phone never returned on /users/me or /crushes; phoneHash + phoneLast4 only.
ObjectId serialisation bug in POST /matches/{id}/messages is confirmed fixed (msg.pop('_id', None) before iso conversion; response is valid JSON, 200).
verify-otp accepts any 6-digit code by design (preview-mode mock) — should be gated behind an env flag before prod (currently always-on).
Mutual-match name reveal works only because /matches/{id}/reveal sets mutualReveal when revealedBy is a superset of participants — verified A→B order produces correct otherName on the next GET.
Frontend auth token is stored client-side and equal to uid (token === uid) — fine for the mock adapter; real Firebase will use idToken and this glue must change.

success_rate.frontend: 92% — all 11 listed UI flows pass except Add Crush search filter

seed_data_creation: Each test mints fresh phone numbers (+9190xxxxxxxxx based on time). User B 'Bobby' created via backend during UI flow to exercise mutual reveal.

After fix to add-crush filter, retest typing 'Aarav' → should show exactly 1 contact.
rca_of_issue: Add Crush search filter: in /app/frontend/app/add-crush.tsx:22-28 the predicate is `name.includes(q) || phoneDigits.includes(qDigits)`. When the user types a name like 'Aarav', `qDigits` evaluates to '' and JavaScript's String.includes('') returns true for every string, so the phone-branch short-circuits the OR to true for every contact. Mitigation: short-circuit the phone branch only when `qDigits.length > 0`.
